overview: The committee approved the April City Council newsletter and discussed a proposed schedule and potential locations for neighborhood ward meetings beginning in September 2026.

items.title: Resolution to publish the city council newsletter
items.summary: Approved the April edition of the city council newsletter, which summarizes recent council business, school repair requests, and departmental budget comparisons. Chair Liz Mullane highlighted the inclusion of specific financial data, and Councilor Justin Tseng suggested adding direct links to budget charts for enhanced resident engagement.

items.title: Resolution to schedule neighborhood ward meetings
items.summary: The committee reviewed a proposed calendar for neighborhood ward meetings running from September through May and kept the matter in committee to finalize dates and locations. Members discussed the importance of hybrid meeting options and identified potential venues within Wards 4 and 5, including local schools and the South Medford Fire Station.
